question: Which of the following banks of India reported a 33 per cent rise in standalone net profit at ₹5,004 crore for the fourth quarter (Q4) of the financial year 2024-25 (FY25)?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Canara Bank**__.

• The bank’s profit growth reflects its ability to manage its business efficiently amidst a competitive and dynamic environment in the Indian banking sector.
 
• This remarkable rise in profit is attributed to **better asset quality, higher interest income, and effective cost management**.
 
• Canara Bank has been consistently improving its financial performance, showcasing a robust operational structure and strategic growth initiatives.
